kb_v1.note: Labels are relative to the lists and their procedure, not to clinical truth. Flip cases are not real patients: findings listed for the gold diagnosis only are removed and findings listed for the other only are added. Lines about a relative use the prefix 'About the patient's <relative>: '.
kb_v1.procedure: A finding listed for one diagnosis only excludes the other. If findings of both exclusive lists are present, or of neither, the criterion does not decide.
kb_v1.purpose: Knowledge-base triplets: DDXPlus patients edited by script, criterion rendered from the DDXPlus lists (stage 2, secondary analysis 8); the renderer serves comparison (11)

mcv_v1.note: Labels are the rule code's points on the released (or edited) entity dictionary, relative to the score text shown. Edited notes are not real patients.
mcv_v1.plausible_ranges: lowest and highest value released per score, input and unit in the training rows
mcv_v1.purpose: MedCalc-V: criterion claims and edits on clinical notes with the score definition shipped in the instance (stage 2, comparisons 7-9)

templates.affirm_ever: On review, the patient has a history of {np}.
templates.negation: On review, the patient is free of {np}.
templates.subject: The patient's {rel} has {np}.
templates.time: The patient had {np} some years ago, and it has since cleared.

xr_v1.name: test
xr_v1.semantics: Every case states a visit date. 'Within the W months before the visit date' counts an event on or after the date exactly W calendar months before the visit; that boundary day counts, and the rule text says so. Rendered events keep at least two months from every window edge. All rules are synthetic (grammar scenarios); every item is a synthetic intervention on the applicability clause.
